lines.1: I headed out so I'd reach the meeting place fifteen minutes early.
lines.2: I couldn't let Konoe be the one waiting.
lines.3: 「And here I thought I'd be early. She's already here.」
lines.4: I watched Konoe from a distance.
lines.6: What was she doing here so early?
lines.7: Let's watch her for two or three minutes.
lines.10: She was just waiting for me.
lines.11: Oh, she was checking her face in a mirror.
lines.12: 「...I guess she's worried about how she looks.」
lines.13: She was naturally good-looking, so I'd figured she wouldn't have to worry about things like that.
lines.17: 「I was trying not to keep you waiting.」
lines.18: 「You've still got a lot to learn.」
lines.20: 「Can't you come up with something a little wittier?」
lines.21: 「Any guys try to hit on you?」
lines.22: 「It's not like that kind of event happens very often.」
lines.23: 「I only got hit on once when I got to the station.」
lines.24: 「Even once is impressive. You're that attractive.」
lines.27: 「Well, I can't say I minded it.」
lines.30: 「I went out of my way to pick this meeting spot because I want to look around the area.」
lines.31: 「I may be local, but my house is on the other side of the station. We were barely in the same school district.」
lines.32: 「The truth is, I've never really taken my time looking around Dobuzaka.」
lines.33: 「Sure. If you want to shop, I'll carry your bags or do whatever else you need.」
lines.34: 「I promised to repay the favor by taking care of you, after all.」
lines.35: And with that, our leisurely stroll through Dobuzaka began.
